concept: Execute a strict two-stage Battlecruiser technology opening, transition through the first Battlecruiser, then apply sustained pressure with Battlecruisers as the primary force and Marines as support.
rules: Complete the fixed Battlecruiser opening in its defined order before making optional strategic investments.
Keep the early economy focused on Battlecruiser technology; do not delay the first Battlecruiser with expansions, unrelated technology, or alternative army production.
After the opening, target roughly 80% Battlecruisers and 20% Marines.
After Battlecruiser production begins, expand the economy and production capacity only when doing so does not interrupt the next Battlecruiser.
Preserve expensive Battlecruisers and convert early pressure into damage against enemy bases and production.

enter_when: The fixed opening is in progress.
phases.goal: Establish the initial economy, Barracks production, gas income, and Factory required for the Battlecruiser technology path.
guidance: Follow the opening sequence exactly and do not insert optional actions between its steps.
At 12 supply, build one Supply Depot, one Refinery, and one Barracks, then train three SCVs.
At 15 supply, start one Factory.
After the Factory starts, train one Marine, upgrade the Command Center to an Orbital Command, then build the second Refinery.
After the second Refinery starts, train one more Marine and then two SCVs.
Avoid a supply block, but do not spend on optional structures that delay the Factory.

enter_when: The fixed opening has not completed.
phases.goal: Complete the Starport, Fusion Core, and Starport Tech Lab chain required to begin Battlecruiser production.
guidance: Continue the fixed opening without adding an expansion, Hellions, unrelated technology, or extra production structures.
At 17 supply, build one Starport.
After starting the Starport, train one Marine, then two SCVs, then one more Marine.
At 19 supply, build one Supply Depot, one Fusion Core, and one Tech Lab on the Starport.
Keep Marines at the main-base ramp for defense while reserving gas and minerals for the first Battlecruiser.
Finish this phase when the Starport, Fusion Core, and Starport Tech Lab are ready.

phases.goal: Produce the first Battlecruiser and transition from the fixed technology opening into sustainable Battlecruiser production.
guidance: Start the first Battlecruiser as soon as the required technology, supply, and resources are available.
Keep the existing Marines defending the main base until the first Battlecruiser is completed.
Maintain SCV production, supply, and two-refinery gas income without delaying the queued Battlecruiser.
Once the first Battlecruiser is queued, add economy or production only when the next Battlecruiser will not be delayed.
Do not shift resources into an alternative army composition during this transition.

enter_when: At least one completed Battlecruiser exists.
phases.goal: Maintain Battlecruiser-led pressure while scaling the economy and army until the enemy can no longer defend its bases or production.
guidance: Begin offensive pressure as soon as the first Battlecruiser is available rather than waiting for a large army.
Continue producing Battlecruisers as the main army and Marines as supporting ground forces, targeting roughly an 80% Battlecruiser and 20% Marine composition.
Move Marines from pure base defense into support for the Battlecruiser attack after the first Battlecruiser is ready.
Use Tactical Jump only for a safe high-value attack, escape, or reposition; never jump into known anti-air defenses.
Retreat a badly damaged Battlecruiser, especially below roughly 225 health, instead of trading it needlessly.
Expand the economy and add production only when Battlecruiser production remains continuous.
